item.title: Apostles Of Ambition
item.description: Apostles Of Ambition is a Content mod for Core Keeper available on Steam Workshop. Large content expansion: 14+ unique armor sets, 3 unique weapons, a playable music system and a hidden story told through a mystery transceiver. What it does Large content expansion: 14+ unique armor sets and 3 unique weapons Adds a playable music system Hidden story told through a mystery transceiver item Steam Workshop only; supports Japanese How to install Open the Steam Workshop page for this mod and click Subscribe — the game installs it automatically on next launch.
